verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google spend needs rebalancing.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 18 leads at an average cost of $158.95 per lead — and all 18 came from Meta, which spent $740.67 at roughly $41 per lead. Google received $2,120.45 in spend this period and returned only 7 unverified conversions, putting its cost per result near $303. Because of that gap, budget is being shifted toward the channel that is clearly working. Google's daily spend has also shown erratic gaps, which is being addressed to keep delivery consistent through the next period.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta
Meta's cost per lead this period, versus roughly $303 on Google
organic actions from your Google Business Profile this period (calls, direction requests, and site clicks)

watch_item.issue: Google is consuming the majority of ad spend with significantly higher cost per result and gaps in daily delivery.
watch_item.fix: Budget weight is being shifted toward Meta where lead volume and cost efficiency are confirmed, and Google delivery gaps are being stabilized.
